artifacts.summary: 6-phase, 3.75-hour read-only plan: reproduce and commit the kernel-level trace evidence, adjudicate docs/theorem-index.md:113 as accurate and leave it untouched, and deliver the RETIRE disposition plus follow-up briefs, with zero repository edits outside specs/.

memory_candidates.content: When a research phase returns a NEGATIVE/NO-DEPENDENCY verdict on a read-only trace task, the correct plan shape is not re-litigation but three distinct jobs: (1) reproduce the mechanical check at implementation time and commit its VERBATIM output as an evidence file, so the deliverable is a re-runnable machine check rather than prose quoting one; (2) adjudicate the artifact the verdict was about column-by-column and record the mandated no-edit; (3) name the deferred work as ready-to-execute briefs with file_scope and serialization edges. The intended end state is zero repository modifications outside specs/, which must be stated as the designed outcome in the plan's Overview or the task reads as having produced nothing. Also: a plan for such a task must carry an explicit Non-Goal against landing already-proved supporting lemmas into a file owned by a concurrent task, because their cheapness (six kernel-checked lines) makes the write collision the only real cost and therefore easy to overlook.
